name: BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.review20SearchFuelExtension
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (x p g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (fuel extra : ℕ) (l : ℝ)
  (h : Option ℝ) (a : ℝ),
  (BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l h a).1 ≠ none →
    BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ (fuel + extra) l h a =
      BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l h a
